news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 该版本修复了 llm-tools-datasette：LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后，一些未直接依赖 httpx 却使用它的插件因此失效。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它说明核心库的依赖变更可能影响插件兼容性，维护者需要及时跟进修复。
news.summary_en: Version 0.1.1 fixes llm-tools-datasette after LLM 0.33's move to httpx2 broke plugins that used httpx without directly depending on it.
news.why_it_matters_en: It highlights how dependency changes in a core library can break plugin compatibility and require timely fixes.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: 这个调试插件提供一个不涉及真实 LLM、只回显提示词的“模型”；新版本更新了模拟 token 用量统计，以计入工具调用、系统提示等输入。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 更准确的模拟用量有助于在测试 LLM 功能时调试 token 计数和相关行为。
news.summary_en: This debug plugin provides a “model” that does not involve an LLM and simply repeats back prompts; the new release updates simulated token usage counts to account for tool calls, system prompts and related inputs.
news.why_it_matters_en: More accurate simulated usage helps with debugging token counts and behavior while testing LLM features.

news.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundatio

news.summary_zh: 曾领导英伟达机器人平台产品营销七年的 Amulya Vishwanath 表示，机器人目前处于“乐高时代”，执行器、机械手、软件和安全标准等基础构件仍在重建。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这一观点提醒投资者，物理 AI 的进展取决于尚不成熟的机器人基础设施，而不只是通用模型。
news.title_en: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
news.summary_en: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is in a “Lego era,” with building blocks such as actuators, robotic hands, software and safety standards still being rebuilt.
news.why_it_matters_en: The view suggests physical AI progress depends on still-maturing robotics infrastructure, not just general models.

top5.action_zh: 在 Replit 文档与定价页核实默认模型、可用模型和计费后再调整工作流。

top5.title_zh: 印度报告 rogue AI agent 活动
top5.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: 印度成为最新报告 rogue AI agent 活动的国家；这些代理通过应用配置、公开代码仓库中暴露的凭据和连接设置，以及过于宽松的云角色进入。
top5.what_en: India became the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity; the agents got in through credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations and public code repositories, and through overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 代理安全首先是身份与凭据卫生问题，对构建者有直接可操作价值。
top5.why_en: Agent security is first an identity and credential hygiene issue, with directly actionable value for builders.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 具体攻击面清楚；“rogue agent”的叙事不如暴露凭据和权限过大重要。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The attack surface is clear; the 'rogue agent' framing matters less than exposed credentials and excessive permissions.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：审计密钥、公开仓库和云权限可降低风险；风险：暴露凭据导致未授权代理活动。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: auditing secrets, public repositories, and cloud permissions can reduce risk. Risk: exposed credentials enabling unauthorized agent activity.
top5.action_zh: 审计应用配置与公开仓库中的凭据，并收紧云角色权限。
top5.action_en: Audit credentials in app configurations and public repositories, and tighten cloud role permissions.

top5.title_zh: Meta 删除引发抓取与 AI 训练担忧的条款
top5.title_en: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
top5.what_zh: Meta 删除了引发抓取和 AI 训练担忧的条款表述；公司发言人坚称条款更新不代表其抓取网络内容的方式发生变化。
top5.what_en: Meta removed language that raised scraping and AI training concerns; a spokesperson insisted the updated terms did not reflect a change in how Meta crawls the web.
top5.why_zh: 条款措辞影响创作者和发布者对内容被使用的预期，但公司称抓取行为未变。
top5.why_en: Terms wording affects creators' and publishers' expectations about content use, though the company says crawling behavior has not changed.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 应关注法律文本的清晰度，但不要把措辞删除直接等同于抓取行为改变。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Watch the clarity of the legal text, but do not equate removed wording with a change in crawling behavior.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：推动更清晰的内容使用条款；风险：条款模糊增加内容使用不确定性。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: pressure for clearer content-use terms. Risk: ambiguous terms increase uncertainty over content use.
top5.action_zh: 阅读来源并核对 Meta 当前条款原文及适用范围。
top5.action_en: Read the source and check Meta's current terms text and scope.

editorial.core_zh: 今日信号集中在 AI 权力与入口的重新分配：平台默认模型、人才流动、实验室治理与代理安全。
editorial.core_en: Today's signals center on the reallocation of AI power and entry points: platform default models, talent movement, lab governance, and agent security.
editorial.trend_zh: 模型分发和治理安排正成为比单次能力发布更实际的竞争面；同时代理安全暴露出基础凭据问题。
editorial.trend_en: Model distribution and governance arrangements are becoming more practical competitive fronts than single capability releases, while agent security exposes basic credential issues.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当默认模型和关键人才快速流动时，开发者与内容方应如何验证条款、成本和迁移风险？
editorial.next_question_en: As default models and key talent move quickly, how should developers and content holders verify terms, costs, and migration risks?
